item.title: Top 84 entries in third Street Fighter 6 Art Contest revealed, public voting period is now open
item.description: <p>While <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/08/alex-teaser-trailer-sf6/">Alex</a> is still a few months away from releasing, Street Fighter 6 is at least trying to do something to keep the community engaged for the game.</p> <p>Capcom has now revealed the top 84 entrants for the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/nov/28/street-fighter-art-contest/">third Street Fighter Art Contest: New Challengers Edition</a>.</p>

item.title: Former Tekken boss Katsuhiro Harada reveals there's still a secret he hid in Tekken 7 that hasn't been discovered yet
item.description: <p>Although <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/09/bandai-namco-future-departure-harada/">Tekken 8</a> has been trucking along for almost two years already, there's apparently an interesting reason to go back to the last game.</p> <p>Former Tekken Director <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/08/katsuhiro-harada-departure-bandai-namco/">Katsuhiro Harada departed Bandai Namco at the end of last year</a>, and he says he left something behind that fans haven't found yet.</p
